kind: additive erratum; the frozen file is not rewritten

fields.why: the generator computed sum(conditions per family) * seeds + seeds, adding an extra 20 for the GEO linear floor that the per-family sum had already counted. The ladder the same file enumerates is 4 (RAW) + 5 (GEO, including the linear floor) + 4 (HYBRID) = 13 conditions x 20 seeds = 260, which is exactly what X0012 froze and executed (expected membership 260; sealed membership 260/260). The error was arithmetical and never affected the design: the frozen membership and the sealed result both say 260.
fields.generator_fix: tools/s14/s14_run.py now computes the cell count from the enumerated ladder rows directly, so the declared count can never disagree with the enumeration again

fields.correct_reading: loss divided by parameter count is NOT a capability or efficiency score: it mechanically decreases as the denominator grows. The matched frontier itself (exam loss at matched budgets, with exact counts and mismatches reported) is the measurement. The sealed result's capability_per_1000_params field is retained as arithmetic, not as a score, and the report derives no claim from it.
fields.analyser_fix: tools/s14/s14_analyse.py renames the field to loss_per_1000_parameters_mechanical and labels it as not an efficiency score

fields.recorded_reading: which named geometry families materially affect the static evaluator
fields.correct_reading: the lesion table says THIS FROZEN SENTINEL (the HYBRID 12K-budget seed-0 model) is sensitive to these input groups at inference; it is not a general statement of feature importance across models, budgets or seeds
fields.analyser_fix: tools/s14/s14_analyse.py narrows the reading string to sentinel sensitivity

unaffected: the ladder itself, the frozen geometry manifest, the teacher/exam contract, every seed
the sealed 260-cell membership and all measured contrasts
